pages.label: Cover
pages.description: The Costume, Issue #1. Two Black friends, one in a red cape and teal suit and one in a charcoal hoodie, stand together on a two-tower bridge. A tree grows from an open book behind them; a paper boat floats below. You Got the Alien Right Here. One friendship. One future. Too many messages.

panels.description: A phone vibrates beside a mug and a small book-leaved plant in a quiet living room.
Javell, in his gray hoodie, looks at his phone on the couch.
A close-up of the phone shows Javell's message.
The red-caped hero smiles at his phone. An open book fills the shield on his chest.
Wearing glasses and a white shirt, the hero studies his phone.

dialogue.speaker: Hero
dialogue.text: I think I just figured it out.

panels.description: His shadow on the wall already wears a superhero's cape.
He works at a cluttered desk. A paper boat rests beside the unfinished work.
He looks at his own image on the phone and adjusts his glasses.
The hero opens his white shirt to reveal the book shield and teal suit. His red cape flares behind him.
With his hood up, Javell gives him a skeptical look.
Javell pulls at his hoodie's collar, unimpressed.
On a rooftop at sunset, the hero adjusts his glasses while Javell stands beside him with folded arms.

dialogue.speaker: Javell
dialogue.text: All that under the shirt and you still scared to make a move.

panels.description: Javell stands beside a board of plans, notes and connecting red string against the night skyline.
Javell folds his arms and starts his challenge.

dialogue.speaker: Javell
dialogue.text: If I had half what you had…

panels.description: The hero strikes a confident pose, his cape billowing behind him.
Holding a small notebook with a bridge sketch, Javell points toward the hero and finishes his thought.
The hero lands on a rooftop with a dramatic crouch, cracking the concrete.
He puts a hand over his chest and makes a solemn declaration.
A cannabis bud is fused with glowing green crystal facets: chronic and kryptonite in one suspicious object.
The hero points toward the green object. Javell asks for clarification.
A wisp of smoke curls beside the hero as Javell holds the glowing green stash.
In the workshop, Javell spreads his arms over a table of plans. Tools and a team photograph hang behind him.
The hero folds his arms and grins.

dialogue.speaker: Hero
dialogue.text: Bro think he cool 'cause he assembled the whole team.

panels.description: Against a glowing burst, the hero holds up a comic with himself on its cover.
The hero gestures at the comic while Javell folds his arms across the table.
An open notebook of bridge sketches lies on the workbench beside pencils and a small plant.
Roots spread across the pages of an open book beneath a growing sapling.
The hero holds his glasses and pauses for a sincere thought.

dialogue.speaker: Hero
dialogue.text: You know this is our legacy.

panels.description: Javell points at a bridge sketch beside the wooden model on the desk.

dialogue.speaker: Javell
dialogue.text: So we planting something, or you just showing me your wood?

panels.description: An imagined future on Mars: a young descendant looks across a colony toward a two-tower suspension bridge.
A young descendant looks up with a hopeful expression.

dialogue.speaker: Imagined descendant
dialogue.text: What are the odds we get to live on Mars?

panels.description: A montage moves from patched clothing to a workshop, a boat and a floating craft.
Children gather around an elder under a starry sky. Above them, the two friends appear in a vision of building the bridge together.

dialogue.speaker: Caption
dialogue.text: Started with a little wood and a lot of confidence.

panels.description: In the workshop, the red-caped hero stands confidently with a hand on his hip.

dialogue.speaker: Hero
dialogue.text: Everybody on my back. It don’t matter. I’m Superman.

panels.description: In a thought-cloud, the hero imagines carrying an entire bridge, cars and all.
Under the imagined weight, he strains and sweats as concrete cracks above him.
Back in the workshop, the exhausted hero wipes his brow. Javell offers a small notebook and a skeptical look.

dialogue.speaker: Javell
dialogue.text: You said you could go all night.

dialogue.speaker: Hero
dialogue.text: Why you gotta say it like that?

panels.description: The wooden bridge model lies among broken pieces and scattered drawings on the workshop floor.
A piece of the wooden model hits the floor with a small impact.
Javell kneels to gather the broken pieces while the hero covers his face.
Javell holds up his bridge notebook and speaks gently to the subdued hero.

dialogue.speaker: Javell
dialogue.text: I said stop playing small. I didn't say do it alone.

panels.description: An open sketchbook shows the bridge and its missing support. The friends’ hands rest beside the drawings.
The hero opens the notebook in surprise. Javell stands beside him with folded arms.

dialogue.speaker: Hero
dialogue.text: You had this the whole time?

dialogue.speaker: Javell
dialogue.text: You been texting the whole time.

panels.description: Hands in teal sleeves and gray sleeves work together to fit the wooden bridge supports.

dialogue.speaker: Javell
dialogue.text: Two hands on the job. Try not to make that weird.

panels.description: The completed bridge stands between the friends under a desk lamp; a green glow lights the workbench.
Moon photographs, clippings and connecting red string fill Javell’s research board.
The hero glances back over his shoulder with a grin.

dialogue.speaker: Hero
dialogue.text: You looking for aliens on the moon...

panels.description: He points at the open-book shield on his chest.
Javell points to the unfinished side of their bridge model.

dialogue.speaker: Javell
dialogue.text: Cool. The alien can finish this side.

panels.description: A finished wooden suspension bridge sits on the workbench as the hero waters the small plant.
A phone camera frames a photograph of the completed bridge.
A phone shows the photograph being shared instead of another long message.
Both friends smile beside a glowing open book and the tree growing from its pages.

dialogue.speaker: Caption
dialogue.text: Look at that. We actually finished together.

panels.description: The hero poses on a comic cover while Javell is squeezed into its edge.
The cover turns back as a pencil draws Javell fully into the picture.
Both friends now share the cover beneath the book-tree, above a bridge and a small paper boat.
The two friends face each other, smiling and trading one last joke about the cover.
The opening living room returns: the same phone, mug and small plant beside the couch.
A phone shows the comic attachment and the friends’ final exchange of messages.

dialogue.speaker: Hero
dialogue.text: My bad for blowing your phone up.

dialogue.speaker: Javell
dialogue.text: I believe in you too. Now let me sleep.

panels.description: Javell sits on the couch, smiling softly at his phone.
The phone screen shows a typing indicator and the quiet final delivery status.
